gloss: to rebuild, to restore, to recover

definitions.explanation: To build again something that has fallen down or been destroyed.

definitions.gloss: to restore, to revive, to turn around
definitions.explanation: To restore something (business, finances, health, etc.) to a good state after it has declined.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{壊|こわ}れた{家|いえ}を{立|た}て{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I rebuilt the house that was destroyed by the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{経営|けいえい}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to turn around the company's management.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}を{立|た}て{直|なお}すために{休|やす}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm resting to recover my health.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive).

CONJUGATION (godan): {立|た}て{直|なお}す → {立|た}て{直|なお}さない → {立|た}て{直|なお}した → {立|た}て{直|なお}して

COMPOUND VERB: {立|た}てる (to build, to stand up) + {直|なお}す (to fix, to redo)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {経営|けいえい}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す (turn around management)
- {生活|せいかつ}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す (rebuild one's life)
- {体調|たいちょう}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す (recover one's health)
- {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す (revise/redo a plan)

The 〜{直|なお}す pattern indicates doing something over again or redoing it properly.
